exceptions.rationale: Built but never run on Veritra keys: the timing issues sit in the NIST-curve arithmetic, and Veritra pins MLS_128_DHKEMX25519_AES128GCM_SHA256_Ed25519 (audit-rust.sh fails if the pin changes). The fix needs crypto-bigint 0.7.6+, i.e. elliptic-curve 0.14, which no released OpenMLS stack accepts yet. Approved by the owner on 2026-10-24.
